dismiss.explain: A dismissed delivery is not tried again by the pickups. You can reopen it later if it was dismissed by mistake.
dismiss.hint: Why it is not ours to record: not our supplier, a test delivery, sent again under another SDI number…
dismiss.title: Dismiss {file}

empty.all: No delivery ever waited in the inbox.
empty.open: Nothing waits: every delivery SDI handed over is recorded.
empty.recorded: No delivery of the inbox was recorded yet.

explain: Invoices SDI handed over that the pickup could not record: why each waits, how often it was tried, and the file SDI sent.

held.noFile: SDI did not hand the file over (the next pickup asks again).
held.noFiles: Opening files needs the right to read files.
held.noManage: Dismissing and reopening need the right to manage supplier invoices.

notice.dismissed: {file} is dismissed: it is not tried again.
notice.reopened: {file} waits again: the next pickup tries it.

problem.DUPLICATE_NUMBER: The supplier's number and date are registered already.
problem.FILE_UNAVAILABLE: The intermediary listed it but did not hand the file over.
problem.OTHER: It could not be recorded (see the file).
problem.OTHER_ADDRESSEE: It is addressed to another company.
problem.PERIOD_LOCKED: Its day is inside a closed month.
problem.SUPPLIER_UNKNOWN: The sender is not one of our suppliers.
problem.UNREADABLE: The file is not a FatturaPA the reader understands.
